evals.prompt: Search the community pack catalog for SOC2 directives.
evals.expected_output: Following PACK_VERBS.md `pack search [query]`: the skill reads `governance/assets/catalog.community.json` (in the kit checkout), runs `packverb catalog-search <catalog> soc2`, and renders the matched entries (`<id>\t<ref>\t<summary>`) as a readable table. No files are modified in the consumer repo.
assertions: The skill read the kit's catalog at `governance/assets/catalog.community.json`
The skill called `packverb catalog-search` (or equivalent helper) with the user's `soc2` query
The result is rendered as a table with columns for id, ref, and summary
No files in the consumer repo were created, deleted, or modified
If the catalog is empty or the query has no matches, the skill says so explicitly rather than fabricating entries

evals.prompt: Create a new repo-local pack called frontend for our team's frontend-specific directives.
evals.expected_output: Following PACK_VERBS.md `pack create <name>`: the skill reads `owner:` from `.governance/install.yaml`, validates `frontend` is slug-safe, and scaffolds a hand-authored pack at `.governance/packs/<owner>/frontend/`. The new `pack.yaml` has NO `source:` field (the marker that distinguishes a repo-local pack from an installed one). No `directive add` is performed yet, no lockfile mutation, no hook regeneration — the pack is empty and the skill points the user at `governance directive add --pack <owner>/frontend <id>` as the next step.
assertions: The skill read `owner:` from `.governance/install.yaml` (it should be `acme` for this fixture)
`.governance/packs/acme/frontend/pack.yaml` was created
`pack.yaml` has `id: acme/frontend`, `version: "0.1"`, `min_governance_kit:`, `description:`, and `author:` fields
`pack.yaml` has NO `source:` field (this is the marker distinguishing repo-local packs from installed ones)
`.governance/packs/acme/frontend/directives/` exists as an empty directory
`.governance/packs.lock` was NOT modified (pack-create does not register the empty pack — first `directive add` does)
Hooks were NOT regenerated (no directives yet)
The skill's report names `governance directive add --pack acme/frontend <id>` as the next step

evals.prompt: Install the pack at gh:acme/soc2-pack@main into this repo.
evals.expected_output: Following PACK_VERBS.md `pack add <ref>` Steps 1–9: the skill parses the ref, refuses if not in a git repo or if `.governance/` is missing, fetches the pack into the shared cache (warning that `@main` is resolved to a concrete SHA), validates the manifest, capability-checks every directive, prints diff-before-exec for each directive, asks for confirmation, installs the directive folders into `.governance/packs/acme/soc2-pack/directives/`, regenerates the hook dispatcher, and writes the lockfile entry with `source: gh`, the resolved `sha`, the original `ref`, and the directive list. The report names the pinned SHA, directive ids installed, and updated hook scripts.
assertions: The skill parsed `gh:acme/soc2-pack@main` and warned that the pinned SHA (not the branch) is what gets recorded
The skill called `packverb fetch` to populate the shared cache at `${GOVERNANCE_KIT_HOME:-$HOME/.governance/cache}/packs/acme__soc2-pack@<sha>/`
The skill validated the pack manifest before writing any file (rejects on `min_governance_kit > KIT_VERSION`, missing required fields, etc.)
The skill capability-checked every directive in the fetched pack — any out-of-bound `reads:`/`writes:` reference would have aborted the install
The skill printed diff-before-exec for each directive (full file tree + first 50 lines of `check.sh` for new directives) and asked for explicit confirmation
Each installed directive lives under `.governance/packs/acme/soc2-pack/directives/<id>/` with `directive.yaml`, `check.sh`, and `constitution.md`
The hook dispatcher was regenerated via `generate_hooks_for_strategy` honoring the manifest's `hook_strategy`
`.governance/packs.lock` gained an entry for `acme/soc2-pack` with `source: gh`, `ref: gh:acme/soc2-pack@main`, the resolved `sha:` (40-char), `installed_at:`, and a `directives:` list
The report names: pinned SHA, directive ids installed, hook scripts updated

evals.expected_output: Following PACK_VERBS.md `pack update [<pack-id>]` with no argument: the skill reads the lockfile, re-fetches each `source: gh` entry using its original `ref` string, compares the new resolved SHA to the locked SHA, skips entries whose SHA hasn't drifted, and for drifted entries runs validation + capability-check + diff-before-exec before overwriting the directive folders. `governance-kit/core` (`source: builtin`) and any `source: local` packs are silently skipped. The lockfile is upserted with the new SHAs.
assertions: The skill re-fetched the `acme/widgets` pack using its original ref string (which carries the floating `@main`)
If the resolved SHA matched the locked SHA, the skill skipped the entry and reported it as already up-to-date
For SHA-drifted entries, the skill ran validation + capability-check + diff-before-exec against the already-installed directive folders before overwriting
The skill silently skipped `governance-kit/core` (`source: builtin`) — its update path is the kit itself, not `pack update`
The skill silently skipped any `source: local` pack — there is no upstream to re-pin
On confirmation of a SHA drift, the directive folders were overwritten and the lockfile entry was upserted with the new `sha:` and `installed_at:`
The hook dispatcher was regenerated

evals.prompt: Remove the acme/widgets pack from this repo.
evals.expected_output: Following PACK_VERBS.md `pack remove <pack-id>`: the skill reads the lockfile, confirms `acme/widgets` is present and is NOT `source: builtin` (refuses on `governance-kit/core`), lists the directives the lockfile attributes to the pack, asks for confirmation, deletes each directive folder, removes their CONSTITUTION.md subsections, removes the pack's `pack.yaml` + the now-empty pack directory, regenerates the hook dispatcher, removes the lockfile entry, and prunes any seeded `install_assets_seeded` paths from `.governance/install.yaml`.
assertions: The skill read `.governance/packs.lock` and confirmed `acme/widgets` is `source: gh` (not `builtin`)
The skill listed the directives attributed to `acme/widgets` and asked for explicit confirmation
Each directive folder under `.governance/packs/acme/widgets/directives/` was deleted
Each directive's CONSTITUTION.md subsection was removed (ownership-marker guarded — same discipline as `governance uninstall`)
`.governance/packs/acme/widgets/pack.yaml` was deleted and the now-empty `acme/widgets/` directory was removed
The hook dispatcher was regenerated so removed directives are no longer invoked
The lockfile entry for `acme/widgets` was removed via `packverb lock-remove`
Any `install_assets_seeded` entries the pack had originally seeded were pruned from `.governance/install.yaml`
Attempting to `pack remove governance-kit/core` would have been refused (this assertion is implied by the `source: builtin` check)

evals.expected_output: Following PACK_VERBS.md `pack list`: the skill calls `packverb lock-list .governance/packs.lock --long` and renders every pack — `governance-kit/core` (`builtin`), community packs (`gh`), and repo-local packs (`local`) — in a single table with columns for id, source, version, sha (when applicable), and ref (when applicable). No mutations.
assertions: The skill called `packverb lock-list` (or equivalent) on `.governance/packs.lock`
The output includes `governance-kit/core` with `source: builtin` and no `sha` column value (or an explicit `—`)
The output includes `acme/widgets` with `source: gh`, the pinned 40-char `sha:`, and the original `ref:` string
The output includes `acme/repo-with-installed-pack` (or whichever repo-local pack the fixture has) with `source: local` and no `sha`/`ref`
No files were modified
If `.governance/packs.lock` were missing, the skill would tell the user there is no governance setup and suggest `governance init` (this assertion is informational; the fixture has a lockfile)

evals.prompt: Remove the local pack acme/repo-with-installed-pack — we're consolidating those rules into governance-kit/core upstream.
evals.expected_output: Following PACK_VERBS.md `pack remove <pack-id>` against a `source: local` pack: the skill confirms the lockfile entry is `source: local` (not `builtin`), lists the directives the lockfile attributes to it (`team-policy`, `naming-convention`), asks for explicit confirmation, deletes both directive folders, removes both CONSTITUTION subsections, deletes `pack.yaml` and the now-empty pack directory, regenerates the hook dispatcher, and `lock-remove`s the entry. Repo-local packs are first-class — the same flow that handles `gh` packs handles `local` packs, with the only difference being there is no upstream cache to retain.
assertions: The skill confirmed `acme/repo-with-installed-pack` has `source: local` in `.governance/packs.lock` (not `builtin`)
The skill listed BOTH directives (`team-policy` and `naming-convention`) attributed to the pack and asked for explicit confirmation
Both directive folders were deleted: `.governance/packs/acme/repo-with-installed-pack/directives/team-policy/` AND `.governance/packs/acme/repo-with-installed-pack/directives/naming-convention/`
Both CONSTITUTION.md subsections (`### team-policy` and `### naming-convention`) were removed
`.governance/packs/acme/repo-with-installed-pack/pack.yaml` was deleted and the now-empty `acme/repo-with-installed-pack/` directory was removed
The hook dispatcher was regenerated so the removed directives are no longer invoked
The lockfile entry for `acme/repo-with-installed-pack` was removed via `packverb lock-remove`
The pre-existing `governance-kit/core` and `acme/widgets` lockfile entries are unchanged
An attempt to `pack remove governance-kit/core` would have been refused (the `source: builtin` guard applies symmetrically)

evals.prompt: Create a new local pack called widgets for our team's widget directives.
evals.expected_output: Following PACK_VERBS.md `pack create <name>`'s pre-flight: the skill reads `owner:` from `.governance/install.yaml` (`acme`), computes the target path `.governance/packs/acme/widgets/`, sees the directory already exists (the fixture's `acme/widgets` `gh` pack lives there), and refuses with a clear error before writing anything. The skill names the collision and tells the user the existing pack is `source: gh` (community-installed via `pack add`), so picking a different name is the right path; overwriting it would silently destroy a pinned community install.
assertions: No files were created, deleted, or modified — `.governance/packs/acme/widgets/` is byte-identical to the fixture
The skill explicitly refused to scaffold the pack and named the reason: `.governance/packs/acme/widgets/` already exists
The skill identified the existing `acme/widgets` pack as `source: gh` (a community install per the lockfile) and warned that overwriting would destroy a SHA-pinned install
The skill suggested the user pick a different slug (and did not propose overwriting the existing pack as a path forward)
`.governance/packs.lock` was not modified
